title: Implement explainable sample-quality gates
objective: Repair the backend/frontend quality-reason vocabulary mismatch and add privacy-safe machine-readable gate evidence plus honest per-sector confidence explanations without changing scoring or confidence decisions.
forbidden_changes: Do not change formula 1.1, classifier rules, scoring, confidence thresholds, confidence decisions, or existing reason-code emission semantics.
Do not modify collectors, providers, storage, CLI, workflows, frontend page structure, dependencies, or deployment behavior.
Do not add credentials, cookies, login-dependent automation, fabricated data, predictive claims, or personal data.
Do not modify the integration branch, merge, push, deploy, or publish.
deliverables: Canonical backend reason-code contract and deterministic machine-readable gates
Additive optional schema/export support with malformed-gates omission and legacy compatibility
Chinese actual-versus-threshold dashboard explanations with safe fallbacks
Backend/frontend drift test and boundary/export/schema coverage
acceptance_criteria: Existing confidence values and reason_codes are unchanged for identical inputs.
Payloads with and without gates validate, and malformed gates do not discard the remaining sample_quality object.
Every canonical backend reason code has an escaped Chinese frontend label.
The dashboard explains failed gates using only public aggregate evidence and preserves legacy fallback behavior.
All repository quality gates pass and the delivery stays inside write_scope.
verification_commands: python -m compileall -q mom_index scripts tests pipeline.py
